limitations: Initial HTTPS verification through an internal-only Docker network timed out. The original attempt and restored storage were retained; a separate ordinary Docker bridge with loopback-only HTTPS passed without changing TLS trust or restored data.
Transport startup and exact restored keys/storage were checked. No native desktop session, public NAT traversal or Internet certificate renewal was exercised.
The existing Windows customer credential was read privately on that guest and used for a device-status API check against the restored endpoint; its configured server and credential were not changed.
This qualifies the independent Linux lab recovery path. Full Windows company-server recovery remains separate.
